reason: A proposes a physically credible oxide-dispersion-strengthening strategy directly applicable to refractory HEAs, with testable high-temperature and irradiation comparisons, although its processing route and quantitative targets need refinement. B is fundamentally misframed because CoCrFeNi/CoCrFeMnNi are not refractory HEAs, its cited irradiation evidence does not establish high-temperature mechanical improvement, and increased dislocation density or compressive stress is not inherently evidence of better irradiation resistance.
